title: Buddha Jumps Over the Wall
synopsis: “Buddha Jumps Over the Wall” is a famous soup in China that makes even a Buddhist monk ravenous.

fullText.simplified:
佛为什么要跳墙

    你听说过佛跳墙吗？佛跳墙是中国福建的一道名菜，使用的材料十分丰富、名贵，制作过程也非常复杂、耗时，所以在全中国都非常有名。
    做佛跳墙的时候，首先要把各种海鲜、猪肉、鸡肉、羊肉、火腿等食材一一处理完毕，然后用一个大酒缸，把所有的材料依次摆放在里面，加入高汤和黄酒，小火慢炖三个多小时。
    做好的佛跳墙，有一种非常浓郁的香气。相传连僧人闻到了这种香气，都会馋得立刻放下佛书，跳过墙头而来，更不用说普通人了。这也是这个特殊菜名的由来。说到这里，你想尝一尝佛跳墙的味道吗？
fullText.traditional:
佛為什麼要跳牆

    你聽說過佛跳牆嗎？佛跳牆是中國福建的一道名菜，使用的材料十分豐富、名貴，製作過程也非常複雜、耗時，所以在全中國都非常有名。
    做佛跳牆的時候，首先要把各種海鮮、豬肉、雞肉、羊肉、火腿等食材一一處理完畢，然後用一個大酒缸，把所有的材料依次擺放在裡面，加入高湯和黃酒，小火慢燉三個多小時。
    做好的佛跳牆，有一種非常濃郁的香氣。相傳連僧人聞到了這種香氣，都會饞得立刻放下佛書，跳過牆頭而來，更不用說普通人了。這也是這個特殊菜名的由來。說到這裡，你想嘗一嘗佛跳牆的味道嗎？

sentence_translations: Why Did Buddha Jump Over the Wall
Have you heard about “Buddha jumps over the wall”?
“Buddha jumps over the wall” is a famous dish from Fujian province in China.
The materials that are used are extremely rich and rare, ..
.. and the process of making it is also extremely complicated and time-consuming.
It is extremely famous all over China because of that.
When making “Buddha jumps over the wall”, you first take all kinds of seafood, pork, chicken meat, mutton, and ham ..
.. and finish processing the ingredients one by one.
You then use a large wine jar, take all the materials and successively put them inside, ..
Add soup-stock and mulled rice wine, and simmer slowly for over three hours.
The finished “Buddha jumps over the wall” will have an extremely strong fragrance.
According to legend, even a Buddhist monk that smells this aroma, ..
.. will have a craving and immediately drop his Buddhist scripture and jump over the wall to taste it.
This is also the origin of the name for this particular dish.
This being said, do you want to try the taste of “Buddha jumps over the wall”?
